sentences.en: On land the combined armies fared ill.

sentences.en: The album fared well on the charts, and an Anaheim, California concert promoting the album led to a live DVD in The Show Must Go Off! series.

sentences.en: I fared fine during the first 5 minutes, but then they just bombarded me with Germans.

sentences.en: The Lego Star Wars games have fared surprisingly well in the crowded Star Wars games market.

sentences.en: Research the lender's history, particularly how they fared through the 2008 housing crisis.

sentences.en: Soap Zone's All My Children site also features a "Ratings" section, which allows fans to see how their favorite Pine Valley characters fared against other soaps during a particular week.

sentences.en: The Twilight movies have become monster hits, and the soundtracks that accompany each film have also fared well with music fans.
sentences.vi: Các bộ phim của Chạng vạng đã trở thành những bộ phim ăn khách, và các bản nhạc phim đi kèm với mỗi bộ phim cũng trở nên phổ biến với người hâm mộ âm nhạc.
